parameters.name: top
parameters.label: TOP
parameters.description: 3D texture input (Texture 3D TOP).

parameters.name: channel
parameters.label: Channel
parameters.description: Color channel to sample from 3D texture.

parameters.name: resmult
parameters.label: Resolution Multiplier
parameters.description: Output density multiplier (0.01-4).

parameters.name: inside
parameters.label: Inside
parameters.description: > (Density): values above threshold are inside. <= (Signed Distance): values below threshold are inside.

parameters.name: threshold
parameters.label: Threshold
parameters.description: Threshold value where surface is created.

parameters.name: extend
parameters.label: Extend
parameters.description: Boundary handling for 3D texture sampling.

parameters.name: uniquepoints
parameters.label: Unique Points
parameters.description: Whether points are shared between triangles or unique per triangle.

parameters.name: rerangep
parameters.label: ReRange P
parameters.description: Re-range point positions to new range.

parameters.name: tolow0
parameters.label: Map to Low X
parameters.description: New minimum X position.

parameters.name: tolow1
parameters.label: Map to Low Y
parameters.description: New minimum Y position.

parameters.name: tolow2
parameters.label: Map to Low Z
parameters.description: New minimum Z position.

parameters.name: tohigh0
parameters.label: Map to High X
parameters.description: New maximum X position.

parameters.name: tohigh1
parameters.label: Map to High Y
parameters.description: New maximum Y position.

parameters.name: tohigh2
parameters.label: Map to High Z
parameters.description: New maximum Z position.

parameters.name: nmlmethod
parameters.label: Normals Method
parameters.description: How to compute normals: No Normal, Field Gradient, or From Surface.

parameters.name: nmlstepmul
parameters.label: Step Multiplier
parameters.description: Multiplier on gradient step size for Field Gradient normals.

parameters.name: texture
parameters.label: Texture Coordinates
parameters.description: Output texture coordinate attribute (Tex).

parameters.name: allocfract
parameters.label: Fraction of Max Allocation
parameters.description: GPU memory allocation fraction. Increase if points/primitives are missing.

parameters.name: cpureadback
parameters.label: Copy Topology Info Back to CPU
parameters.description: Copy point count and topology info from GPU to CPU.

parameters.name: inputattrscope
parameters.label: Input Attribute Scope
parameters.description: Attribute to sample from POP input (for 3D POP grid mode).

parameters.name: posattrib
parameters.label: Use Position Attribute
parameters.description: Use P attribute to position surface (POP input mode).

• Experimental:Point File In POP: Permite cargar archivos externos que contienen nubes de puntos en TouchDesigner, específicamente diseñado para este tipo de datos. • Experimental:Point Generator POP: Un operador generador que crea nubes de puntos directamente. Puede generar puntos con sus primitivas correspondientes. • Experimental:Point POP: Las fuentes proporcionadas no ofrecen una descripción detallada de la función específica de este operador más allá de su listado. • Experimental:Polygonize POP: Las fuentes proporcionadas no ofrecen una descripción detallada de la función específica de este operador. • Experimental:Primitive POP: Puede eliminar las primitivas de un POP, dejando solo los puntos. También permite crear tiras de línea. Si lo deseas, puedes usarlo para crear primitivas en su pestaña correspondiente. • Experimental:Projection POP: Permite crear y modificar atributos de color y textura. Al igual que el Normalize POP, genera atributos normalizados. • Experimental:Proxim

examples.name: Noise Isosurface
examples.description: Texture 3D TOP (3D noise) → Polygonize POP (Threshold=0) → Normal POP → Render

examples.name: Dynamic Volume
examples.description: Feedback TOP + Noise → Texture 3D TOP → Polygonize POP (animated isosurface)

examples.name: POP Grid Iso
examples.description: Grid POP (3D, Slices>1) → Noise POP → Polygonize POP (POP input mode)

commonCombinations: Texture 3D TOP → Polygonize POP (volume to mesh)
Grid POP (3D) → Noise POP → Polygonize POP (POP input)
Polygonize POP → Normal POP → Render TOP
Polygonize POP → GLSL POP (custom surface shaders)

troubleshooting.solution: Check Threshold — ensure data exceeds it. Try different Inside mode (> or <=).
Reduce Resolution Multiplier. Lower input texture resolution.
Increase Fraction of Max Allocation if info popup shows max numbers reached.
Switch Inside mode between > (Density) and <= (Signed Distance).
Polygonize POP only accepts 3D input in TD 2025.3 — use Trace POP for 2D.

description: Creates 3D polygonal surfaces enclosing pixels/points exceeding a threshold. Works with 3D textures (Texture 3D TOP) or 3D POP grids using marching cubes algorithm. In TD 2025.3, only accepts 3D input — use Trace POP for 2D. Supports ReRange P for position remapping.
